issue_context.title: hptc ycsb-worloade: Modify lookupTableTask to return merged rows, and improve AppendRows
issue_context.body:
## Description

Every row from resultTask has its own chunk, even if their column definitions are same. This makes it impossible to `appendColumn(chk.columns[0], rows.columns[0])`, i.e. append one column of lots of rows
 to another column of the chunk(or the result) at once.

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/tree/master/executor/distsql.go#L67-L70

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/executor/distsql.go#L1139-L1141

Modify lookupTableTask to return merged rows(maybe a chunk), gc may be improved by less live objects, `AppendRows` may make use of this feature to append data more efficiently. 

The task is to improve AppendRows by trying append one column of multiples rows, in one shot, or several slice `append`.

If, sadly, that the definition of `columns` needs to be modified to get the issue done, the difficulty will be much larger, and should have higher rewards.

## Score

- 600

- @xhebox
